Volume > Open Interest (Vol > OI): Verifies fresh position initiation rather than institutional profit-taking/unwinding.

Synthetic Options Delta/Gamma Modeling: Tracking implied volatility shifts, tick-volume imbalance, and order flow velocity to infer institutional options hedging pressure on spot/futures.
